Goals, shared decisions, features and dependencies

Keep parent task author as integration owner

span.p: Reuse the relevant project decision or resolve it with the owner

span.p:
Published leaf brief
Decision versions, contracts, owned paths, state needs,
examples, real entry point and required check IDs

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Planner fixes visible expected results. oracle-author writes
the held-back rule cases without seeing the task split
Kernel checks red-before-green and pins binding and runner

span.p:
Catalog of about 20 skills, downloaded from the most-used public skills
and vetted. infer-or-ask is ours. Name, trigger, stack, digest

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Feature owner selects skills for this task
Filter eligible entries by task type, stack and tool access

div.style: color: rgb(20, 58, 48) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Pin skill IDs and digests
Optional skills carry a trigger

span.p:
Ready to run?
Check references, skills, tool scope, context and reserved budget

div.style: color: rgb(20, 58, 48) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Kernel grants a fenced attempt and isolated workspace
Supply the current brief and skill references

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Load required guidance once
Open an optional skill only when its trigger applies

span.p: Implement, run development checks and submit candidate

span.p:
Clean verifier collected all pinned cases?
Lease and input versions still current?

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Return failing rule and observation
Cap repeated repair and escalate by failure type

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Ask for the missing fact or flag conflicting guidance
Owner amends task or changes skill assignment

div.style: color: rgb(20, 58, 48) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Kernel accepts candidate commit and verifier receipt
Wake dependent tasks once

and runs the feature acceptance case
